territorial_scope.description: Applies to the Secretary of Health and Human Services and to Medicare payment models under title XVIII of the Social Security Act, within the United States.

evidence.quote: The Secretary of Health and Human Services may not implement the innovative payment and service delivery model

agora_applications: Medicine, life sciences and public health

summary.short: Bill that bars the HHS Secretary from implementing the WISeR prior-authorization payment model described at 90 Fed. Reg. 28749 or any substantially similar model, and bars selecting future CMI model tests that would apply prior authorization, including through AI, to traditional Medicare services.
summary.long: The Ban AI Denials in Medicare Act is an introduced bill. Section 2(a) provides that the Secretary of Health and Human Services may not implement the WISeR model described in a notice dated July 1, 2025 (90 Fed. Reg. 28749), or any substantially similar model. Section 2(b) amends section 1115A(b)(2) of the Social Security Act to add a limitation on model selection: beginning on the date of enactment, the Secretary may not select a model to be tested if the model would provide for prior authorization, including through artificial intelligence, for items or services payable under Part A or Part B of title XVIII. The operative provisions bind only the Secretary. The bill sets out no penalties, enforcement mechanisms, definitions of artificial intelligence, or exceptions, and it cites the WISeR notice by reference without restating its contents.

relations.target_text: Social Security Act, section 1115A(b)(2) (42 U.S.C. 1315a(b)(2)), title XI
relations.note: Sec. 2(b) strikes 'The Secretary shall select' in subparagraph (A) and adds a new subparagraph (D) limiting models that provide for prior authorization (including through the use of artificial intelligence) under part A or part B of title XVIII.

evidence.quote: Section 1115A(b)(2) of the Social Security Act

relations.target_text: Medicare Program; Implementation of Prior Authorization for Select Services for the Wasteful and Inappropriate Services Reduction (WISeR) Model, 90 Fed. Reg. 28749 (July 1, 2025)
relations.note: Sec. 2(a) prohibits the Secretary from implementing the innovative payment and service delivery model described in this notice, or any substantially similar model. The notice is identified by citation only; its text is not part of this document.

notes: The short title and the Sec. 2(b) heading refer to AI, but the operative text is not limited to AI: Sec. 2(a) bars the WISeR model or any substantially similar model, and Sec. 2(b) bars any CMI model providing prior authorization, with AI named only as one included method. Sec. 2(b) applies from enactment ('Beginning on the date of the enactment of this subparagraph'); Sec. 2(a) states no date. The text is the introduced bill; the WISeR notice is cited by Federal Register citation only.

thresholds.note: The bill contains no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment. The prohibitions in Sec. 2(a) and Sec. 2(b) (adding Sec. 1115A(b)(2)(D) of the Social Security Act) apply by model identity and by the type of prior authorization, not by a number. The Federal Register citation (90 Fed. Reg. 28749, July 1, 2025) and the effective date 'the date of the enactment' are not thresholds.
